bucketNotes.title: Safety School:
bullets: You have a high chance of acceptance (75% or higher).
Your academic profile (GPA, test scores, class rank) exceeds the school's average for admitted students.
Think of it as a "sure thing" or a school where you're a strong candidate.

bucketNotes.title: Target School:
bullets: Your chances of acceptance are in the middle range (25-75%).
Your academic profile falls within the average range of students admitted.
These schools are neither "easy wins" nor out of reach.
Consider these schools where you're a competitive applicant.

bucketNotes.title: Reach School:
bullets: You have a lower chance of acceptance (less than 25%).
Your academic profile is below the school's average for admitted students.
Think of it as a "dream school" or a school where you're stretching your chances.
